body_markdown:
Jeep Heritage, a used parts salvage yard in Johnson City, Texas, is moving from one side of town to the other, and it’s using the move as a reason to reduce inventory. The outfit is offering lots of used parts at half off their normal prices. If you’ve been searching for parts to repair or restore your full-size Jeep and can make the drive to Texas Hill Country, now might be the time to consider a road trip.


We called Jeep Heritage and spoke to Brandon Krivohlavy, who filled us in on the sale. Brandon is also a sales manager for[Vigilante 4×4](https://www.hagerty.com/media/market-trends/hagerty-insider/at-this-meticulous-texas-shop-theres-two-ways-to-skin-a-jeep/) , which produces completely rebuilt, restomod versions of vintage full-size Jeep models. That means J-series pickups and SJ Cherokee, Wagoneer, and Grand Wagoneer SUVs. To sustain a steady flow of restorations, Vigilante sources plenty of used donor vehicles and sells the parts it updates or replaces on new builds through Jeep Heritage. Since Vigilante uses its own proprietary frame, that means that there are lots of viable frames and even some complete rolling chassis that could underpin a restoration project.


Jeep Heritage


Jeep Heritage


Jeep Heritage


Brandon told us that the location, 128 Martin Bros Lane, in Johnson City, Texas, features used, mostly unrestored parts, pulled from a wide variety of full-size Jeep models. That includes entire frames, body panels, grilles, engines and engine parts, instrument clusters, axles, transfer cases, seats, and seat belts, among other parts. Jeep Heritage is hoping to wrap up the sale on Saturday, August 29, before it moves the parts to its new location. Every part that’s sold to customers this week is one less part to move. The more they sell, as Brandon put it, “the less sweat we have to endure.”

[Jeep Heritage](https://www.jeepheritage.com/used-parts-warehouse-sale) is taking reservations to come by and shop its inventory of parts.[Click here to find an available spot](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0/appointments/schedules/AcZssZ0JmbM9EXJgO-HCUQJv_jmEql7Y2xL9mUAVG1F5CxF8L991blM3vvHkbF65gtJcMDDo7oBUAG8K) . Everything is first come, first served. Johnson City is located about an hour west of Austin and an hour north of San Antonio. We’re not too familiar with the area, but it’s Texas, so even if you don’t find every last piece on your full-size Jeep restoration shopping list, you can surely find some BBQ on your trip.
